picks.title: 🛣️  Choose Independence Over Dependence
picks.summary:

picks.reason: Discusses illusion and security from Bhakti Yoga and modern science, linking to spiritual awakening.

picks.title: 1823: Life Is Sacred and Life Is Everywhere | The Earth Personified in Krishna's Pastimes
picks.summary: In the form of a beautiful teenager God enters a new city, meets a hunchback girl in the street, transforms her body and enters a romance with her. On the surface it sounds bizarre. But read with the right eyes, it is rich in ecological and theological depth. The girl is an expansion of Mother Earth herself, bent low under the burden of wicked rulers. Krishna straightens her out, indicates the value in loving nature personified, and demonstrates how God can reciprocate with all varieties of love. Srimad Bhagavatam 10.42. 1-18  *******************************************************************
picks.reason: Explores Krishna's pastimes with Mother Earth, blending theology and ecology deeply rooted in Hindu scripture.
